Body.Content:
What and Why:

Plugins are coming to PowerPoint for Windows, adding new skills and connectors that extend what Copilot can do. Plugins bring specialized capabilities and information from connected services into presentation workflows.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out mid-November 2026 and expect to complete by early December 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Users will be able to discover and use plugins available to them in Copilot within PowerPoint for Windows, helping them create and refine presentations with capabilities and content relevant to their work.

Action Required/Recommendations:

Admins can review available plugins and manage access for their organization in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
